sentences.text: Coloradisaurus is a genus of massospondylid sauropodomorph dinosaur.
The holotype, which is the specific specimen the species is based on, was estimated to measure 3 meters in length and weigh 70 kilograms.
The genus is known from two distinct specimens.
All known fossils were discovered in 1971 at the La Esquina locality in Argentina.
Modern consensus classifies Coloradisaurus as a massospondylid closely related to Lufengosaurus and Glacialisaurus.
Coloradisaurus lived during the Norian stage of the Late Triassic, approximately 213 million years ago.
The estimated time range for this genus spans between 227.3 and 205.7 million years ago.
